title: Auditory Neuropathy Spectrum Disorders: From Diagnosis to Treatment: Literature Review and Case Reports

title: Chinese Clinical Practice Guidelines for Auditory Neuropathy (gCAN)

title: Auditory Neuropathy Characteristics in Children with Cochlear Nerve Deficiency

title: Speech Perception in Individuals With Auditory Neuropathy

title: Speech and language outcomes in children with auditory neuropathy/dys-synchrony managed with either cochlear implants or hearing aids

title: Cochlear Implant Outcomes in Cochlea Nerve Aplasia and Hypoplasia

title: Multicentre gene therapy for OTOF-related deafness followed up to 2.5 years
